pipeline.title: Make Peer Execution failures diagnosable
pipeline.why_first: Every later wave that needs a real worker will otherwise fail as TASK-001 provider FAIL with empty changed_files and no stderr. Seven measured runs at c3081ee; re-verify at current HEAD.
pipeline.do_not: Re-run make campaign to 'see if it works'. Fix retention first.

work.title: Retain worker stdout/stderr on FAIL
work.acceptance: Failure receipt includes bounded stderr/stdout text behind a debug flag or on FAIL; digest remains. A reproduced FAIL names the actual error.

work.title: Resolve candidate_sha vs denied git add/commit
work.acceptance: Either the worker may create the candidate commit it must return, or the controller records candidate identity from the worktree without requiring the worker to git commit. Contract and permissions agree. changed_files empty is no longer forced by this contradiction.

work.title: Re-probe one 1-file local_write task at current HEAD
work.acceptance: Receipt shows turns, changed_files, and stderr text. If still 13 turns / zero edits, that is now a named defect with logs, not a guess.

pipeline.title: Semantic fidelity — no silent loss of human meaning

pipeline.warning: Rule 95: do not weaken tests to hide loss. Change the contract those tests encode, then prove lowercase retention.
